description: Browse the Tensorust dataset catalog: 145 entity-level datasets built from public records (SEC, USAspending, FCC, CMS, EPA, DOL, USAC, county rolls and more), each row an organization, site, loan or filing with its own number: money owed, at risk, unclaimed, mispriced or about to expire, usually with a deadline. Filter by query (words matched on name, one-line summary, audience and description) and category; returns slug, name, one line, category, row count, tiers, dataset page and the free 25-row sample link, 20 per page (50 max) with next_offset. Pass category='list' to get the categories with counts. Free.

category.description: Category name or part of it, e.g. 'private credit', 'property', 'compliance'; 'list' returns all categories

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'going concern', 'E-Rate', 'BDC non-accrual', 'hospital'

name: list_datasets
title: List Tensorust datasets
